name: Amplemarket
description_en:
Amplemarket combines B2B prospect discovery, account signals, AI-assisted research and multichannel sequences. Duo uses company context and CRM information to propose outreach; Unibox collects conversations. Its value proposition is coordination from a reason to contact someone through follow-up, rather than merely storing a lead list. Provider claims about pipeline growth and deliverability were not independently tested.

The official sequence demonstration starts with a reason for outreach and an audience, generates a preview, then adds a condition for whether the lead has a phone number. One branch can contain a call and WhatsApp touch while the other continues the existing stages. For an evaluation, use a small approved event-contact list, review the generated claims, map contact fields and choose channels before launch. This is a proposed test, not a campaign we ran.
description_zh:
Amplemarket 把 B2B 客户发现、账户信号、AI 辅助研究与多渠道序列组合起来。Duo 使用公司背景与 CRM 信息提出触达建议，Unibox 汇集会话。其产品定位是从联系理由一直协调到后续跟进，而不只是存放线索名单。厂商关于商机增长和送达率的宣传未经独立实测。

官方序列演示先指定联系理由与受众、生成预览，再按线索是否有电话号码添加条件。有号码的分支可安排电话和 WhatsApp，另一个分支继续原有步骤。评估时可选一小份经授权的活动联系人，核对生成内容、映射联系字段，并在启动前选择渠道。这是建议的测试流程，并非已执行的活动。

core_features.explanation_en: Branch outreach using available contact data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按已有联系数据分流触达。
统一处理触达会话的回复。

zh: 按实际拥有的联系方式分支
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: The official sequence demonstration starts with a reason for outreach and an audience, generates a preview, then adds a condition for whether the lead has a phone number. One branch can contain a call and WhatsApp touch while the other continues the existing stages. For an evaluation, use a small approved event-contact list, review the generated claims, map contact fields and choose channels before launch. This is a proposed test, not a campaign we ran.
steps.zh: 官方序列演示先指定联系理由与受众、生成预览，再按线索是否有电话号码添加条件。有号码的分支可安排电话和 WhatsApp，另一个分支继续原有步骤。评估时可选一小份经授权的活动联系人，核对生成内容、映射联系字段，并在启动前选择渠道。这是建议的测试流程，并非已执行的活动。

items.en: Shortlist it when sales operations wants research, sequences and reply management together. A CRM remains relevant for the broader customer record; a narrow email sender may be enough for a simple follow-up. Before connecting a CRM and sender accounts, identify who can approve generated messages and handle replies. The sequence page documents templates, A/B tests and branching; it does not make every social or messaging action universally available in every account.
items.zh: 当销售运营希望统一研究、序列与回复管理时，可将其列入候选。完整客户档案仍可能需要 CRM；简单跟进也可能只需邮件发送工具。连接 CRM 与发送账户前，应明确谁批准生成消息、谁处理回复。序列页记录了模板、A/B 测试与条件分支，但不代表所有账户都能使用每一种社交或消息动作。

items.en: The reviewed pages describe a managed online platform, not a self-hosting distribution. No source-code license was verified. If a channel fails or a reply has already arrived, inspect the conversation and queued stages before retrying; this is operational guidance because exact retry and duplicate-suppression semantics were not established. Account reputation tools are vendor features, not a guarantee of inbox placement or recipient response.
items.zh: 本次页面描述的是托管在线平台，未证实存在自托管发行版或源代码许可。若某渠道失败或已收到回复，应先检查会话和排队步骤，再决定是否重试；这是操作建议，因为尚未确认精确的重试与去重语义。账户信誉工具属于厂商功能，不保证进入收件箱或获得回复。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page advertises Startup at $600/month on an annual term with two users included; Growth and Elite require custom pricing. All plans advertise a free trial, which does not establish a perpetual free tier. The comparison separately meters email-address credits per user per year and phone-number credits. Request a written scope for extra seats, data, dialing and trial duration before treating the starting figure as a total operating budget.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页展示 Startup 为年度期限下每月 600 美元，含两名用户；Growth 和 Elite 需要定制报价。所有套餐宣传免费试用，但这不能证明存在长期免费层。对比表分别列出每用户每年的邮箱地址与电话号码额度。应先取得额外席位、数据、拨号及试用期限的书面范围，再把起价用于运营预算。
